statement: Let T = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} nums[i]. For 0 <= l < n and 0 <= i <= n - l, let S(i,l) = sum_{j=0}^{l-1} nums[i+j], with the empty sum S(i,0) = 0. The function returns a result r and: if there exists l with 0 <= l < n such that for some i with 0 <= i <= n - l we have (T - S(i,l)) mod p = 0, then r is the least such l; if no such l exists, then r = -1.
